posts.headline: Week 11: Ravens-Patriots Is a Must-Win Sweat
posts.body: The bubble is tight, the Chargers are untouchable, and six matchups decide who dances in Week 12. Max Insider breaks down every card.
content: The top of Sandbox is settled for now. The Chargers are 10-0 and nobody is catching them.
Everything else is a fight. Read every card, then check the live scoreboard Sunday.

story: The 49ers and Seahawks are both 3-7 and 5-5, and both are on a three-game losing streak.
Seattle is the one with a real cushion. Roughly 70% playoff odds, and this game can push that to about 87% with a win.
Lose and the Seahawks fall to about 40%. That is a lot of pressure on Cam Ward and Javonte Williams.
Watch Jayden Daniels, too. He projects 26.3 and gives Seattle the ceiling that wins weeks like this.
Matthew Stafford and George Kittle keep San Francisco breathing, but the Niners need a miracle to reach the postseason.
My pick: Seahawks, 139-121.
The Ravens sit at about 32% playoff odds and this game can push them to 55%. A loss leaves them at 11%.
The Patriots are 2-8 and out of the picture, but their names are loud. Trevor Lawrence and Patrick Mahomes are both on the list.
My pick: Ravens, 152-139.
The Bears are 7-3, riding five straight wins, and sitting on roughly 70% bye odds.
Dak Prescott projects 26.1 and Derrick Henry is a strong bench anchor. Chicago wins a lot if the Ravens-Panthers game goes its way.
My pick: Bears, 158-127.
Lions and Eagles, both 6-4, are close to coin-flip bye territory. Philly sits at 17% bye odds, Detroit at 14%.
Christian McCaffrey and Joe Burrow are the Eagles' keys. Josh Allen is Detroit's.
My pick: Eagles, 138-132.
The Chargers are 10-0 on a nine-game streak and about 92% to earn a bye. Denver sits at 8-2 and still in the chase.
Denver needs this win to keep its own bye hopes alive. A loss pushes that to zero.
Bo Nix and Jahmyr Gibbs are the Broncos' best shot. Justin Herbert and Baker Mayfield lead the Chargers.
My pick: Chargers, 160-150.
Chiefs and Bills, both losers of two straight, are scrambling for a playoff path that is nearly closed.
Trey McBride and Bijan Robinson hold the swing. I like Kansas City's depth at tight end.
My pick: Chiefs, 142-118.

closing: The NFL slate is where the bubble fights are won. Check the broadcast window for Seattle and Chicago.
Keep your lineup honest and the standings open all week.

posts.body: Six matchups, one bubble, and a Saturday morning guide to everything you need to watch. Chargers and Broncos are cruising, but the Rams-Lions game could reshape the playoff race.
content: Welcome to Week 10 in Sandbox, where the Chargers sit at 9-0 and nobody is rattled. I'm told the real drama is further down the standings.
Check the live scoreboard all day, because the Rams-Lions tilt is the one that moves the needle most.

story: Boom! This is the featured game and the one I'm most fired up about. The Rams are 3-6 and need this win badly, sitting at about 39% playoff odds.
Win and they jump to roughly 60%. Lose and they fall to about 6%. That is a playoff race in one afternoon.
The Lions are 5-4 and at about 83% to make it, but they can lock down a much bigger share with a win.
Josh Allen (Lions, 30.3 projected) is the engine for Detroit, and he is the player to watch in the NFL game that swings this one.
Here's the thing: BUF at NYJ projects 53.3 points from these two teams' starters, with Allen and Garrett Wilson (Lions, 14.2) right in the middle of it.
